svg.title: Slice-shift recovery auxiliary
svg.desc: Shared stage-0-to-3 encoder and offset head estimate clean and shifted slice flows; a detached clean flow and known relative shifts define a Smooth-L1 training target.

g.aria-label: Training only · Relative-shift supervision without segmentation labels
Offsets are two-component (dy, dx) fields on the H/8 × W/8 grid; targets broadcast spatially.
Smooth-L1 is averaged over flow elements (valid adjacent pairs when a slice mask is supplied).
This auxiliary uses the encoder and offset predictor only; it is absent at inference.
